description: The bar chart compares the performance of three models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents the performance scores, with values ranging from 0.42 to 1.00. For each category, three bars are displayed side-by-side: RedWhale (our) in dark purple, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) in light gray. In the PT-EVAL category, RedWhale achieves a score of 0.42, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.46, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) reaches 1.00. In KoBEST-BQ, RedWhale scores 0.52, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.56, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) again scores 1.00. For KoBEST-CP, RedWhale scores 0.71, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.74, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. In KoBEST-HS, RedWhale scores 0.50, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.54, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. For KoBEST-SN, RedWhale scores 0.69, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.73, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. In the AVG category, RedWhale scores 0.57, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.61, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. Across all categories, the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model consistently achieves the highest score of 1.00, while RedWhale (our) and EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 show lower scores, with EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 generally outperforming RedWhale (our) in most categories.
